fig1_pdf_cdf.svg: The triangular density f(x)=2x (left) and its cdf F(x) (right), where F is built point by point with cdf_from_pdf as the running integral of f from 0 to x. The cdf rises from 0 to 1, steepest where the density is largest.
fig2_prob_area.svg: For the same pdf, P(0.3<X<0.7) is the shaded area under f (orange), computed by prob_between, and equals F(0.7)-F(0.3). The dashed line marks the mean E[X]=integral x f(x) dx from expectation_continuous.
